exampleEvidenceSets.label: Fictional orchard notes — version 1
exampleEvidenceSets.qualification: All three notes are invented examples. Selecting them does not prove spraying happened or satisfy any real job condition.

records.conditionMeaning: Product begins reaching the specified treatment extent.
records.originalText: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE — invented for the draft test. At 10:00 Europe/Ljubljana on 11 November 2026, the example operator reports that Example product A first reached the first row of Example orchard from the example tractor-mounted sprayer.
records.supports: Illustrates a report that product began reaching part of the named orchard.
records.limitations: This invented note is not a real observation. It proves no identity, amount, permission or whole-orchard coverage.

records.conditionMeaning: Specified product application is actively occurring.
records.originalText: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE — invented for the draft test. At 10:20 Europe/Ljubljana on 11 November 2026, the example operator reports spraying Example product A in the third row of Example orchard with the example tractor-mounted sprayer.
records.supports: Illustrates a report of spraying at one moment during the job.
records.limitations: This invented note does not prove continuous spraying, the amounts used or coverage of other rows.

records.conditionMeaning: Every selected treatment segment meets the bound application procedure finish criteria.
records.originalText: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE — invented for the draft test. At 10:45 Europe/Ljubljana on 11 November 2026, the example operator reports that the sprayer stopped. No record of which rows or treatment segments were completed was supplied.
records.supports: Illustrates an end-of-work note linked to the finish condition for review.
records.limitations: Stopping is not proof of finishing the whole job. Evidence for every selected treatment segment is still missing.

product.label: Example product amount — version 1
product.meaning: For this example job, compare the reported amount of Product A with 0.30 litres per hectare. Product and water are separate amounts.
product.qualification: Made-up example check, not a safety limit or permission to use the product. No change from dose to rate is authorised.

water.label: Example water amount — version 1
water.meaning: For this example job, compare water only with 200.00 litres per hectare. Finished spray mixture and a tank total cannot be checked as water per hectare.
water.qualification: Made-up example check, not a safety limit or an approved mixture recipe. It does not prove how much water was used.

jobs.label: Example orchard spray — version 1
jobs.summary: Apply Example product A across the whole Example orchard with the example tractor-mounted sprayer, targeting Example pest.
jobs.qualification: Made-up job for testing only. It is not permission to spray or proof that spraying happened.

instructions: Apply the example product over the whole selected orchard using the example tractor-mounted sprayer.
The fictional plan specifies 0.30 L/ha of product and 200.00 L/ha of water as separate amounts.
Completion requires evidence that every selected treatment segment meets the plan.

conditions.meaning: Product begins reaching the specified treatment extent.
Specified product application is actively occurring.
Every selected treatment segment meets the bound application procedure finish criteria.
